description: Frozen structured continuity state. Edit freeze: this schema must not change during Stage 0/1; changes require a schema_version bump and protocol amendment.
truncation_rule: Serialize categories in truncation_priority order. Within a category, keep items in emitted order while they fit. Whole categories that do not fit at all are dropped; partially fitting categories are truncated item-wise. All removals recorded in build_context provenance.

rules: Extract only information explicitly supported by the transcript
Do not infer undocumented facts or invent decisions
Output must be valid JSON matching the schema
